notes: The 1932–1940 BUF scope excludes later Europe-a-Nation federalism. The primary advocacy archive is identified as interested and checked against contemporaneous JTA and academic research. Opposition to war with Germany does not establish general pacifism. Private firms and profits coexist with corporative production and imperial protection. Christian rhetoric does not establish personal faith. Reviewed all 240 literal statements and directions, all 15 independent axis briefs, contradictory evidence, sources, period, metadata and educated assumptions. Corrected readings of cultural plurality, unconditional refugee settlement and Catholic embryo-enhancement analogies where applicable. All 240 responses remain conservatively inferred, with exact IDs in the separate review. Neutral responses express qualified or competing positions, not a default for uncertainty. Technical checks do not certify historical or political estimates. Neutral-density diagnostics reviewed against each literal mechanism, private/public or institutional trade-off, and counter-evidence; exact warnings and neutral rationales are retained in the separate review.
